channel.title: Match of the Day
channel.desc: Highlights of five Premier League games as title-chasing Arsenal take on Fulham at the Emirates. Relegation-threatened West Ham are in action at Brentford, and Brighton continue their push for European football next season at Newcastle. Elsewhere, Sunderland travels to Wolves, and there's action from the Friday night game between Leeds and Burnley.
